chunks: But when he brought to them Our signs they laughed at them,
ai.seo_question: How did the disbelievers react when the Prophet brought them God's signs?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse highlights the psychological state of the Quraysh elite who, despite witnessing the Prophet's (peace be upon him) eloquent delivery of divine truth, responded with derisive laughter rather than contemplation. Shia exegetes often interpret this mockery as a manifestation of *kibr* (arrogance) and a deliberate refusal to acknowledge the *Haqq* (Truth) due to pride in their ancestral traditions, serving as a precursor to the detailed dialogue in the subsequent verses.
